digest.component_or_area: CI gate steps in GitHub Actions workflows
propositions: Gate steps in _build-and-test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml run repo scripts without if-present guards, causing hard CI failures when the script is absent from the checked-out tree in Gerrit's Verified lane

Gerrit's Verified lane takes the workflow definition from the target branch but checks out the change's tree, so gate steps added on main fail against open changes branched before the script was created
Nine unguarded steps in _build-and-test.yml and two in gerrit-verify.yaml golden-path must be wrapped with early-return guards that skip with a log line when the script is missing
Each guarded step must still fail when the script IS present, preserving the original gate enforcement without weakening
A structural guard in the workflow must fail if any step in a patchset-lane job runs a repo script without an if-present guard, preventing future instances of this defect class
